surface_name: Supabase Auth redirectTo and Redirect URLs allow list
title: Supabase OAuth or magic link ignores redirectTo and sends users to localhost or the Site URL
symptoms: After Google sign-in the browser lands on http://localhost:3000 in production
Vercel preview deployments always redirect to the production Site URL
cause: Auth only honors redirectTo when the exact URL matches an entry in the Redirect URLs allow list; otherwise it falls back to the Site URL with no error.
fix: Add every production, preview, and local callback URL to the allow list, using wildcards for preview domains, and set Site URL to production.
apply:
Dashboard: Authentication > URL Configuration > Redirect URLs
https://example.com/**
https://*-myteam.vercel.app/**
http://localhost:3000/**
affected: Supabase Auth on all plans; email links, OAuth providers, and password reset
